messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliocare.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@heliocare.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pilot - urgent pricing ask

Markus,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We ran the concept with our ML infra and the results look promising — the latency profile fits our clinical use case. Procurement is pulling together the paperwork but there’s a real seat-of-the-pants constraint on price here. Our board is pushing to keep vendor TCO down for the pilot cohort.

Can you extend a 30% off list rate for the first 12 months if we commit to a 12-month pilot (minimum $120k ARR run-rate)? That would get this over the finish line. We can move quickly on an MSA amendment and sign within 2 weeks if we have that concession.

Attached: RFP_summary.pdf (procurement ask + milestones)

—Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Director, Strategic Sourcing
HelioCare
sanjay@heliocare.com
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@heliocare.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pilot - urgent pricing ask

Sanjay —

Appreciate the transparency and the urgency. HelioCare is exactly the sort of strategic health-tech reference we want in-market. I pushed this to the deal desk early today and ran preliminary numbers with Ben/Laura. A couple quick thoughts:

- We can get aggressive on the price if HelioCare commits to a 12-month pilot with the minimum run-rate you shared and a published success criteria (you outlined in the RFP).
- Two options we can consider: 27% off list for 12 months with the MSA amendment + milestone-based usage floors, or 25% off for 18 months with slightly higher upfront commit.

I'm attaching our pricing_model.xlsx so you can see the unit economics and ramp assumptions. Ben/Laura — can you sanity-check margin impact and cadence if we go with 27%?

If HelioCare is okay with the milestone-based language in the SOW we can draft the amendment and aim for signatures in 10 business days.

Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachments: pricing_model.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Aug 2029 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pilot - HelioCare pricing concession request — need >20% exec signoff

Team — escalating from the thread below. HelioCare is asking for a material concession (30% off list) for a 12-month pilot. They are a strategic healthcare prospect with potential enterprise expansion across 6 hospitals if the pilot hits KPIs.

Why this matters:
- Reference value in hospital market (clinical evaluations) could accelerate other customer closes in Q4.
- Committed minimum ~$120k ARR run-rate for 12 months; initial volume steady but margin sensitive.
- Competitive pressure: competitor X already offering deeper short-term economics for pilots.

What I recommend:
- Approve up to 27% off list for 12 months *conditional on* signed MSA amendment, published success milestones in SOW, and escrowed minimum usage/commit.
- Require Sales Ops to add a clause for automatic reversion to standard pricing at renewal and Finance to approve billing schedule.

Attached are the SOW draft and a deal_economics.csv showing discounted unit economics + expected token volume. I included the RFP from procurement.

Asking Mina: can you authorize a concession >20% for this account? If yes, what's the ceiling you are comfortable with (25% vs 27%) and any additional controls we should require?

Date: Fri, 2 Aug 2029 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pilot - HelioCare pricing concession request — need >20% exec signoff

Markus / team —

Thanks for the clear summary and the economics. I reviewed the deal_economics.csv and had a brief with Finance. I will approve a 25% off list concession for the 12-month pilot under these strict conditions:

1) Signed MSA amendment and SOW with the milestone definitions you proposed (clinical pass/fail + usage floor).
2) A minimum committed spend of $120k ARR and a deposit/escrow equal to one month of forecasted usage to mitigate churn risk.
3) Sales Ops to add an automatic pricing revert clause at renewal and notify Finance 60 days before term end.
4) Legal to review redlines and confirm no long‑term indemnity exposure.

I will not approve 30% at this time. If you demonstrate runway to conversion to enterprise accounts after pilot, we can revisit at renewal.

Ben/Laura — please update the deal record in HubSpot with these conditions and prepare the amendment template. Markus — go ahead and confirm to Sanjay that we can do 25% contingent on the items above.

Mina Haddad
VP, Commercial Strategy
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

(Authorized: 25% concession for HelioCare pilot; Finance to review billing cadence)
